main_measure.name: mean of position x (next-day return - coin mean daily return) over forecast>0 bars, same-day cases summed

statistic.name: t of the mean of per-day summed cases

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 on >= 30 cases and Spearman > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2 on >= 30 cases

decided_by: Mean above 0 with t >= 2 on at least 30 cases and Spearman correlation above 0: the confirm rule.
reading: Range multiple uses the 20 recorded bars up to and including t within a window, so active bars without 20 prior bars are left out of the agreement share; the measure is position x (next-day return minus the coin's all-window mean daily return), the 30-case minimum counts (coin, bar) cases with forecast > 0, and the mean and t are taken over per-day sums of those cases.

direction_check.why: no check fold (the plan has none, or the backtest did not run on its folds)
